note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。 無次元x∈[0,1]、両端u=0、中心差分の内点31/63/127。零解から固定ds=0.1で80step。λ=2で上下枝を補正し、λ=4は離散無解の意図的な対照です。擬似弧長は物理時間ではありません。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures. Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet endpoints and 31/63/127 interior nodes. Take 80 fixed ds=0.1 steps from the zero solution. Correct both branches at lambda=2; lambda=4 is a deliberate discrete no-solution control. Pseudo-arclength is not physical time.

name.ja: Bratu非線形境界値問題

note.ja: ここでは−u″=λexp(u)の符号規約。Newton–Krylov法で残差・格子収束・内側線形解法の失敗を確認します。 同じ無次元1次元Dirichlet問題でλ=3、内点63/127、初期値0または4sin(πx)。3Jv×2格子×2枝の12解法と固定η=1e-8の解析Jv対照1本。GMRES restart24/max96、Newton最大24、残差許容1e-9です。
note.en: The convention here is −u″=λ exp(u). Newton–Krylov checks cover residuals, refinement and inner-solver failures. The same dimensionless one-dimensional Dirichlet problem at lambda=3, 63/127 interior nodes, starting from zero or 4sin(pi*x). Twelve mode/grid/branch solves plus one analytic-Jv constant-eta=1e-8 control. GMRES restart24/max96, at most 24 Newton steps and nonlinear tolerance1e-9.

name.ja: 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える
name.en: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小さな1次元の単純foldだけです。分岐曲線の解析族比較では計算した中点値を族の座標に使い、固定λの独立形状比較と区別します。連続foldは離散解そのものではなく、一般の分岐追跡や大規模性能は保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. A small one-dimensional simple fold only. The whole-curve family comparison uses the computed midpoint as its family coordinate and is distinct from the independent fixed-lambda profile checks. The continuum fold is not an exact discrete solution. No general bifurcation-tracking or large-scale performance claim.

note.en: The preserved R3 run passed the shared27 pytest tests and this case’s129 fixed gates: nonzero analytic Jv qualification, discrete residuals, independent analytic branches, mode agreement, forcing, evaluation ledgers, Krylov storage, Armijo and the constant-eta control. Analytic forcing validation is counted separately and does not steer FD/AD iterations.

name.ja: 解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov
name.en: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products

note.ja: 解析解 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。 小1次元BVP向けの教育実装です。ADは四則・exp・境界paddingの方向微分に限ります。小Hessenberg行列と基底は保持します。ηの固定下限があるため、原著EWの漸近収束定理、一般AD/PETScとの同等性、速度向上や大域収束は主張しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory. An educational small1D BVP. AD covers only elementary arithmetic, exp and linear boundary padding. Small Hessenberg matrices and Krylov bases are stored. The fixed eta floor precludes claiming the unmodified EW asymptotic theorem. No general-AD/PETSc equivalence, speedup or global-convergence guarantee.
